title: DCP+
summary: A streaming experience, from the first sign-in to the final frame.
role: Senior Software Engineer · frontend & cross-platform ownership
ownership: Senior Software Engineer · frontend & cross-platform ownership
challenges: Coordinating authentication, purchases, and protected playback across a multi-platform streaming experience.
Controlling repeated SDK initialization and recovery behavior.
contributions: Frontend delivery across web and connected TV.
Authentication, session orchestration, startup and dependency coordination.
Stripe TVOD/SVOD purchasing, subscriptions, rentals, and ownership experiences.
DRM-protected playback with FairPlay and Widevine, player lifecycle handling, and recovery.
Advertising integrations, content discovery, and TV series experiences.
Production diagnostics and regression prevention.
decisions: Used bounded recovery and lifecycle cleanup to reduce repeated SDK initialization.

metrics.label: Initialization requests
metrics.context: Affected cold-start requests in captured local development traces. Not a production-wide metric.

metrics.label: Initialization window
metrics.context: Down from approximately 3–4 seconds in captured local development traces. Not independently verified in production.

images.alt: Abstract editorial artwork for DCP+; not a product screenshot

sections.title: The product context
sections.body: DCP+ brings content discovery, subscriptions, purchases, advertising, and protected video playback together across web and connected TV. The engagement involved substantial frontend and cross-platform ownership.

sections.title: From purchase to playback
sections.body: The work spanned Stripe purchasing and subscription flows, rental and ownership experiences, and protected playback. Authentication and session orchestration connected these experiences with the application startup sequence.

sections.title: Reliability at the boundaries
sections.body: Player lifecycle handling, bounded recovery, and cleanup addressed repeated SDK initialization. Production diagnostics and regression prevention were part of the delivery work. The measurements below describe captured local development traces only.
